title: Quwy universal
features:
QUWY Script 💜 | Universal | Minimalist UI

Description / Features List:

💜 UI & Design:

Minimalist Dark Theme: Clean, AMOLED-friendly interface with purple accents.
Smooth Animations: High-quality tweens for opening, closing, and toggling features.
Minimize System: Folds into a small, draggable floating button ("Q") to keep your screen clean.
Mobile & PC Support: Fully draggable windows and buttons.


🚀 Movement:

Fly: Fully adjustable flight speed.
Noclip: Walk through walls, doors, and objects.
Infinite Jump: Jump in mid-air endlessly.
Click TP: Hold Ctrl + Click anywhere to teleport instantly.


👁️ Visuals:

ESP (Highlight): See players through walls with a glowing outline.
Fullbright: Removes shadows and darkness (Permanent Day).
X-Ray: Makes walls semi-transparent to see hidden areas.
busts Player & Trolling:

Smart Teleport: Teleport to any player easily.
Player Dropdown List: Auto-fills usernames from a dropdown menu for fast teleporting (includes Refresh button).
SpinBot: Makes your character spin rapidly to confuse enemies or dodge shots.


⚡ Character Stats:

WalkSpeed Modifier: Set custom running speed.
JumpPower Modifier: Set custom jump height.
Gravity Control: Change gravity (e.g., Moon gravity).


✅ Other:

Keyless: No key system required.
Universal: Works on Brookhaven RP, Tycoons, Simulators, and most other games.
Notifications: Clean in-script notification system for actions.
